pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
134: O Unas, you have not gone dead, you have gone alive to sit on the throne of Osiris. Your scepter is in your hand that you may give orders to the living, the handle of your lotus-shaped scepter in your hand. Give orders to those of the Mysterious Sites (the dead)!

135: Your arm is that of Atum, your shoulders are those of Atum, your belly is that of Atum, your back is that of Atum, your bottom is that of Atum, your two legs are those of Atum, your face is that of Anubis. The sites of Horus serve you, the sites of Seth serve you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
136: O Unas, beware of the Lake!
To say four times:
The messengers of your Ka have come to you, the messengers of your father have come to you, the messengers of Re have come to you.

137: Go after your sun! You are to purify yourself. Your bones are those of female hawks, the goddesses who are in heaven, so that you may be by the side of the god and leave your house to your son, your procreation. Everyone who shall speak evil against the name of Unas,

138: when you go up, is predestined by Geb to be a despised one of his city, (so that) he shall flee and falter. You are to purify yourself with the cool water of the stars, and you will climb down upon ropes of brass - on the arms of Horus, in his name He-of-the-Henu-Barge.

139: The (glorified) humanity bewail you after the Imperishable Stars have carried you. Enter, then, into the place where your father is, where Geb is! He gives you that which was on the brow of Horus, so that you become powerful and full of glory through it, so that you become the one at the head of the Westerners through it.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
140: O Unas! Your messengers go, your heralds hurry to your father, to Atum.
"Atum, let him rise to you, fold him in your arms!

141: There is no god, who has become a star, without a companion."
"Shall I be your companion?"
"Look at me! You have seen the forms of the children of their fathers, who know their spell, who are now Imperishable Stars".
May you see the two inhabitants of the Palace - this is Horus and Seth!

142: May you bespit the face of Horus and remove his injury! May you catch the testicles of Seth and remove his mutilation! That one is born for you, this one is conceived for you.

143: You are born, O Horus, as the one whose name is He-before-Whom-the-Earth-Quakes:
(you are conceived, Seth, as the one whose name is) He-before-Whom-the-Sky-Shakes.
Such a one has no mutilation (Horus),
such a one has no injury (Seth),
such a one has no injury, such a one has no mutilation,
(So) you have no injury, you have no mutilation.

144: You are born for Osiris, O Horus!
You have become more glorious than he,
You have become more powerful than he.

145: There is no seed of a god which has perished, neither (has he) who belongs to him. You will not perish, (you) who belongs to him. Re-Atum does not give you to Osiris, he does not reckon your heart, he has no power over your breast. Re-Atum does not give you to Osiris, he has no power over your breast.

146: Osiris, you cannot have power over him, your son cannot have power over him. Horus, you cannot have power over him, your father cannot have power over him.

147: You belong, O this one, to this god, as the Twins of Atum said:
"Lift yourself up", so said they, "in your name God", and so you become Atum for every god.

148: Your head is that of Horus of the Duat, O Imperishable One, your brow is the One-with-the-Two-Eyes, O Imperishable One, your ears are the twins of Atum, O Imperishable One, your eyes are the twins of Atum, O Imperishable One, your nose is a jackal, O Imperishable One, your teeth are Sopdu, O Imperishable One:

149: your arms are Hapy and Dua-mutef, which you need to ascend to heaven, and you ascend, your legs are (those of) Imsety and Kebeh-senuf, which you need to descend to the lower sky, and you descend. All your members are the twins of Atum, O Imperishable One! You did not pass away, your Ka does not pass away.
You are Ka!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
150: To say:
I have come to you, Nephthys, I have come to the Evening Barge, I have come to you, True-is-She-over-the-Red, I have come to you, She-Who-Remembers-the-Kas. Remember him, this Unas!

151: Orion is encircled by the Duat, when the One-Who-Lives-in-the-Horizon purifies himself: Sothis is encircled by the Duat, when the One-Who-Lives-in-the-Horizon purifies himself. This Unas is encircled by the Duat, when the One-Who-Lives-in-the-Horizon purifies himself. He is content because of them, he is refreshed because of them, in the arms of his father, in the arms of Atum.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
152: To say:
Re-Atum, Unas comes to you, an Imperishable Spirit, Lord of Dispensation in the site of the four papyrus columns. Your son comes to you, this Unas comes to you, that you (both) may stride over the sky, united in darkness, that you may rise on the horizon in the place where you like to be.

153: Seth and Nephtys, hurry! Announce to the gods of the South and their spirits: He comes indeed, this Unas, an Imperishable Spirit!
If he wills that you will die, you will die;
If he wills that you will live, you will live.

154: Re-Atum, Unas comes to thee, an Imperishable Spirit, Lord of Dispensation in the site of the four papyrus columns. Your son comes to you, this Unas comes to you, that you (both) may stride over the sky, united in darkness, that you may rise on the horizon in the place where you like to be.

155: Osiris and Isis, hurry! Announce to the gods of the North and their spirits: He comes indeed, this Unas, an Imperishable Spirit, like the Honored One (star) over the Nile, so that the spirits in the waters honor him. Whom he wills that he live, he lives. Whom he wills that he die, he dies.

156: Re-Atum, this Unas comes to you, an Imperishable Spirit, Lord of Dispensation in the site of the four papyrus columns. Your son comes to you, this Unas comes to you, that you (both) may stride over the sky, united in darkness, that you may rise on the horizon in the place where you like to be.

157: Thoth, hurry! Announce to the gods of the West and their spirits: He comes indeed, this Unas, an Imperishable Spirit, decked like Anubis on the neck, who rules over the Western height, that he may reckon hearts and that he may have power over breasts! Whom he wills that he live, he lives. Whom he will that he die, he dies.

158: Re-Atum! Unas comes to you, an Imperishable Spirit, Lord of Dispensation in the site of the four papyrus columns. Your son comes to you, this Unas comes to you, that you (both) may stride over the sky, united in darkness, that you may rise on the horizon in the place where you like to be.

159: Horus, hurry! Announce to the Eastern souls and to their spirits: He comes indeed, this Unas, an Imperishable Spirit! Whom he wills that he live, he lives. Whom he will that he die, he dies.

160: Re-Atum! your son comes to you, Unas comes to you. Let him ascend to you! Enfold him in your embrace! This is the son of your body, eternally.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
161: To say:
O Osiris, this Unas comes indeed, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit, to reckon hearts, to take Kas, to grant Kas. His every appointment obliges one (to do his duty), him who he has elevated, and him who applied to him (for it).

162: There is no one who withdraws because he will have no (more) bread, his Ka will have no (more) bread, his bread will be withheld from him. Geb said, and it came forth from the mouth of the Ennead:
"Hawk, after he has seized (his own)!" so they said, "Lo! you are ensouled and powerful!".

163: He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable spirit, he that bore more than you, he that suffered more than you, he that is more weary than you, he that became greater than you, he who will be happier than you, he who roars louder than you. You have no more time there! Lo, this is what Seth and Thoth have done, your two brothers, who could not bewail you!

164: Isis and Nephtys, come together, come together, unite! He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit.

The Western Ones, those who are upon earth, belong to this Unas -
He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit.
The Eastern Ones, those who are upon earth, belong to this Unas -
He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit.
The Southern Ones, those who are upon earth, belong to this Unas -
He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit.
The Northern Ones, those who are upon earth, belong to this Unas -
Those who are in the Lower Sky belong to this Unas -
He comes indeed, this Unas, weary of the Nine, an Imperishable Spirit!?

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
167: To say:
Atum, this your son is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - This Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged! He judges - this Unas judges!

168: Shu, this your son is here, Osiris, who you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

169: Tefnut, this your son is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

170: Geb, this your son is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

171: Nut, this your son is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

172: Isis, this your brother is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

173: Seth, this your brother is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive, and who lives that he may punish thee - he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

174: Nephthys, this your brother is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

175: Thoth, this your brother is here, Osiris, whom has been preserved alive, and who lives that he may punish you. He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

176: Horus, this your father is here, Osiris, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

177: Great Ennead, this Osiris is here, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

178: Little Ennead, this Osiris is here, whom you have preserved alive - he lives! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

179: Nunet, this your son Osiris is here, of whom you have said: "He is born for your father." You have wiped his mouth, his mouth has been opened by his son Horus, who is his beloved, his members have been reckoned by the gods.

180: He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

181: In your name of He-in-Heliopolis-While-Enduring-Everlastingly-In-His-Necropolis, he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

182: In your name of He-in-Busiris, Chief of his Provinces, he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

183: In your name of He-in-the-Castle-of-the-Scorpion, the appeased Ka, he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

184: In your name of He-in-the-Divine-Hall, He-in-fumigation, He-in-the-Chest, He-in-the-Shrine, He-in-the-Sack, he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down - he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

185: In your name He-in-the-White-Chapel-of-Paar-wood, he lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: He has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged! He judges, this Unas judges!

186: In your name of He-in-Orion, your time is in heaven, your time is on earth. Osiris, turn your face so that you see this Unas,

187: your seed which came out of you, the penetrating one! He lives - this Unas lives! He is not dead, this Unas is not dead: he is not gone down, this Unas is not gone down: he has not been judged, this Unas has not been judged. He judges, this Unas judges!

188: In your name of He-in-Buto, may your arms be about your meal, your daughter,

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
194: The doors of the horizon open themselves, its bolts slide.
He has come to you, Net (crown of Lower Egypt), he has come to you, Nesert (Uraeus), he has come to you, Great One, he has come to you, Great of Magic, purified for you, in awe before you.

195: Be pleased with him, be pleased with his purification, be pleased with the words he says to you: "How beautiful is your face when you are pleased, when you are new and young!
A god has given you birth, the father of gods".
He has come to you, O Great of Magic!
It is Horus who fought to protect his eye, Great of Magic.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
196: O Net (crown of Lower Egypt), O Inu, O Great One! O Great of Magic, O Nesert (Uraeus) ! 197: Inspire fear before Unas as fear before you, inspire dread before Unas as dread before you, inspire awe before Unas as awe before you, inspire love for Unas as love for you!
Let him rule at the head of the living, [let him be powerful] at the head of the spirits, let his knife be firm against his enemies!

198: O Inu, [you came forth from him, he came forth from you].
The Great Ikhet [has given you birth], Ikhet-Utet has adorned you, the Ikhet-Utet has given birth, the Great Ikhet [has adorned you], for you are indeed Horus who fought to protect his eye.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
199: To say the words:
Stand upon it, upon this land [which came out of Atum, the spittle] which came out of the Becoming One!
May you become over it, may you be high over it, so that your father sees you, so that [Re] sees you!

200: He [comes] to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Re, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Overthrown One, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Penden, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Wanderer,

201: he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Great Bull, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Great Raft, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Sopdu, he comes to you, O his father, he comes to you, O Sharp-of-Teeth (Sopdu).

202: May you grant that this Unas seize the Cool Region (the sky) and receive the horizon! May you grant that this Unas rule over the Nine, so that he provide the Ennead (with gifts)! May you give the herdman's staff into the hand of this Unas, so that the head of Lower and Upper Egypt be bowed (in reverence)!

203: He comes down (to meet) his adversary and stands up, the greatest Chief in his great Kingdom. Nephthys praised him after he had captured (?) his adversary.

204: You have adorned yourself as Great-of-Magic (Seth), He in Ombos, Lord of the South. It will not be lost for you, it will not cease for you. Lo, you are full of glory, powerful one, more than the gods of the South, together with their spirits!

205: You who the Pregnant One ejected when you did cleave the night, adorned are you like Seth, who came out forcibly! (But) more fortunate is he whom Isis praises:

206: You have adorned yourself as Horus with the two pupils (?). It will not be lost for you, it will not cease for you. Lo, you are full of glory, powerful one, more than the gods of the North, together with their spirits!

207: You make yourself free of what should be washed away for Atum in [Heliopolis, and you go down] with him. You judge the wants in the Netherworld and stand (as king) over the places of the primeval ocean. You come into being with your father Atum, you are high with your father Atum, you rise with your father Atum. The wants (of the Netherworld) are severed from you, your head (is held) by the nurse of Heliopolis.

208: You go up and open the way through the bones of Shu (air), the embrace of your mother Nut enfolds you, you purify yourself on the horizon and leave that which should be purified from you in the Lakes of Shu.

209: You go up, you go down. You go down with Re, darkened with Nedy. You go up, you go down, you go up with Re and you rise with the Great Raft.

210: You go up, you go down, you go up with Nephtys, darkened with the Evening Barge. You go up, you go down, you go up with Isis, you rise with the Morning Barge.

211: You have power over your body, there is no one to oppose you. You are born because of Horus (in you), you are conceived because of Seth (in you). You have purified yourself in the Hawk nome (Third Nome of Lower Egypt), you have received your purification in the Uninjured-Ruler Nome (Thirteenth Nome of Lower Egypt) before your father, before Atum.

212: You have come into being, you have become high, you have become a spirit! Cool it is for you in the embrace of your father, in the embrace of Atum.

213: Atum! Elevate to you this Unas, enfold him in your embrace! This is your son of your body, eternally.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
214: To say:
To stir up, to turn around, O! O! O Unas, stand up, sit down to the thousand of bread, to the thousand of beer! The roast of your double rib is from the (king's) slaughter house, your Reteh-bread from the Wide Hall.

215: As a god is supplied with the offering meal, Unas is supplied with this his bread. You have come to your soul, Osiris, who is mighty among the spirits, who is mighty in his places, who is under the protection of the Ennead in the Prince's Hall.

216: O Unas, come up to me, betake you to me, do not be far from the tomb, your protection (?)! I have given you the Eye of Horus, I have reckoned it to you. May it be pleasant for you!

217: O Unas, stand up, receive this your bread from (my) hand! O Unas, I am your helper!"

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
218: To say:
"Awake, Unas! Turn around, Unas! You have gone to give orders to the places of Horus, you have gone to give orders to the places of Seth, you have gone to give orders to the places of Osiris.

219: May the king give the gift, in all your honors,

220: in all your places! Your lotus-shaped scepter is at the head of the living, your staff is at the head of the spirits, like Anubis at the head of the Westerners, like Anedjty at the head of the Western nomes.

221: How pleasant is your condition! You become a spirit, o Unas, among your brothers the gods. How changed, how changed (is your state)! (Therefore) protect your children! Beware of your border which is on Earth! Put on your body and come towards them!
(To say) four times:

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
118: Let the hoers be in jubilation, the heart of Thesesu-breast be exalted! They have swallowed the Eye of Horus, the healthy one, the one in Heliopolis. The finger of Unas, the small one, draws out that which is in the navel of Osiris.

119: Unas is not thirsty, he is not hungry, the heart of Unas is not faint (?), for the arms of the Desert God keep away his hunger! Fill! Make the hearts full!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
120: To say:
O you who preside over the offerings, O you who belong to Plenty, Unas has been directed to Fetek, the cupbearer of Re! Re has directed him himself. Re sends him to the overseers of provender of this year: what they seize, they give it to him; they take hold of and they give him barley and spelt, bread and beer.

121: For it is to Unas that his father granted, that Re granted, barley and spelt, bread and beer. For it is he, the Great Bull who strikes Nubia, for to Unas, indeed, belong the five portions of bread, drink and cakes in the Hall, three (of which) are in the sky with Re, two are on earth with the two Enneads.

122: For he is the unbound one being unbound, for he is the seen one being seen. Says(?) Re: "It is better for him today than yesterday".

123: Unas has united himself to the Moist, he kissed the Dry Seat, Unas joined himself to the flame, Unas unites himself to the Beautiful One, he is afraid of Shu who disperses and scatters (?). It is indeed the Beautiful One who fears Unas, and she gives bread to Unas: she does him good on this day.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t: (Omitted, because it is identical with Utterance 205)

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
124: To say:
Offering of the butcher, offering of the butcher, offering of that which is in the Eye of Re! Offering of the birdcatcher, of that which is in the eye of the god, the cupbearer who brings water! (Let) the flame burn! The joint together with the pastry!
Four hands (full) of water.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t: (Omitted, because it is identical with Utterance 207)

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
125: To say:
Shu is flourishing. Unas has not taken away his meal! Unas is flourishing. Shu has not taken away his meal! The messengers of the East repeat: "This is your bread!"

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
126: To say:
Judge, arise! Thoth, be high, sleepers wake, the inhabitants of Nubia arise, before the Great Trembler who comes out of the nome, (before) the Opener-of-the-Way who comes out of the bush!

127: Pure is the mouth of Unas! The two Enneads cense Unas. Pure indeed is the tongue which is in his mouth! Excrement is an abomination to Unas. Unas rejects urine, Unas loathes his abomination.

128: The abomination of Unas is this - he does not eat this abomination, (and) like Seth rejects the poison(?) of these two who cross the sky, these are Horus and Thoth. Take Unas with you,

129: that he may eat of what you eat, that he may drink of what you drink, that he may live on what you live, that he may sit on what you sit, that he may be strong in what you are strong, that he may sail in what you sail!

130: The pavilion of Unas is woven in the (Feild of) Rushes, the plenty of Unas is in the Field of Offerings. His offering is among you, you gods! The water of Unas is wine, like that of Re, Unas goes round about the sky like Re, he traverses the sky like Thoth.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
131: To say:
The abomination of Unas is hunger, he does not eat it; the abomination of Unas is thirst, he does not drink it. Unas it is, indeed, who gives bread to the Existing Ones, his nurse is the milk-goddess. It is she who makes him live again, it is she, indeed, who gives Unas birth.

132: Unas is conceived at night, Unas is born at night, for he belongs to the Followers of Re who are before the Morning Star. Unas is conceived in the Watery Abyss, he is being born in the Watery abyss. He has come, he has brought your bread which he has found there!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber East Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
133: To say:
The Eye of Horus trickles on the bush of the djenu-plant. The-One-at-the-Head-of-the-Westerners comes to him indeed, he has brought him the food of Horus-Who-Is-at-the-Head-of-His-Houses. On what he lives, Unas lives on it; of what he eats, Unas eats; of what he drinks, Unas drinks. One joint (and one) cake, this is his offering.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
225: To say:
A serpent is entwined by a serpent, when a young hippopotamus coming on the pasture is entwined. Earth, swallow that which came out of you! Monster, lie down, glide away!

226: The majesty of the pelican falls in water.
Serpent, turn over that Re may see you!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
227: To say:
The head of the great black bull is cut off.
Hepenu-serpent, this I say to you, Kheser-neter-scorpion, this I say to you:
"Turn over, glide into the ground!". I have said this to you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
228: To say:
A face falls on a face, a face has seen a face. The mottled knife, black and green, went forth against it:
it has swallowed that which it tasted.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
229: To say:
This is the nail of Atum upon the dorsal vertebrae of the Neheb-Kau-serpent, which stopped the strife in Wenu. Fall! Glide away!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
230: To say:
Let your two poison glands be in the ground!
Let your two rows of ribs be in the hole!
Pour out the liquid!
The Two Kites stand by.
Your mouth is closed by the follower's tool;
the mouth of the follower's tool is closed by the lynx.
The tired one is bitten by a serpent.

231: O Re, Unas has bitten the earth,
Unas has bitten Geb,
Unas has bitten the father of he who bit him.
This is the being who has bitten Unas,
Unas did not bite him.

232: It is he who comes against Unas.
Unas does not go against him.
The second moment later he sees Unas,
the second moment later he perceives Unas.
If you bite Unas, he will make you one,
if you look on Unas he will make you two.

233: The male serpent is bitten by the female serpent,
the female serpent is bitten by the male serpent.
Heaven is enchanted, earth is enchanted,
the Male behind mankind is enchanted.

234: Enchanted will be the god Blind-is-his-head.
You, yourself, scorpion, will be enchanted.
These are the two knots of Elephantine which are in the mouth of Osiris (Unas), knotted for Horus over the backbone.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
235: Your bone is (made) into a harpoon by which you will be harpooned.
Hearts are removed(?),
the nomads are in the place of the spear,
they are overthrown.
This is the god Hemen!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
236: To say:
Meti, meti, meti, meti!
Tiu, his mother; Tiu, his mother!
Miti, miti!
You are washed, O desert. (Let there be) Water! There is no dust!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
237: To say:
The serpent which came forth from Earth is fallen, the flame which came from the Watery Abyss is fallen.
Fall! Glide away!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
238: To say:
A face is upon you, you who are on your bowels.
Fall on your backbone, you who are in the naut-bush!
Retreat before me, serpent provided with his two faces!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
239: To say the words:
You! Ah ah ah! Filler! Filler!
You are to rape the two (holes) of the (door) stone, door jamb! The two which are!
I, ia, I!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
240: To say:
Kebebhititi-biti-shes, son of Hifget, that is your name!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
241: To say:
Spittle which is not dried up (?), (which has not) escaped into the house of his mother. Beast, lie down!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
242: To say:
The bread of your father belongs to you, O Iki-nehii:
your own bread belongs to your father and to you, O Iki-nehii.
Gold of praise, Khai-tau, this is your ox there, the renowned one, for whose deed (alone) this is being done.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
243: To say:
The White Crown should go forth, after she has swallowed the Great, after the tongue of the White Crown has swallowed the Great, so that the tongue is not to be seen.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
244: To say:
The Uraus serpent is for the sky; the centipede of Horus is for the earth.
Horus, an oxherd, treads;
Unas has trod upon the walk of Horus.
Unas knows not, Unas is not knowing.

245: A face is upon you, you who are in his naut-bush.
You should be lain on your back, you who are in his hole (in your hole).
Meat for the pot of Horus, escape into the earth!
O let the beast, O desert, glide away!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
246: To say:
Spit of the wall, vomit of the brick, what comes out of your mouth will be thrown back against yourself.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
247: To say:
Extinguished is the flame!
The flame-serpent is not to be found in the house of he who possesses Ombos.
It is a serpent which will bite, which has slipped into the house of him whom it will bite, that it may remain in it.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
248: To say:
Two hetes-scepters and two hetes-scepters for two djema-ropes and two djema-ropes!
As bread!
Interlace then!
You should be here indeed, you should be here indeed.
Servant! Take away!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
16: Osiris, seize every one who hates Unas,
-libation-
who speaks evil against his name!
Thoth, go, seize him for Osiris!
Bring the one who speaks evil against the name of Unas, place him in your hand!
To say four times:
Do not separate yourself from him,
take care that you not be separated from him.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
17: He goes who goes with his Ka. Horus goes with his Ka, Seth goes with his Ka. Thoth goes
To say four times: - Burning incense - with his Ka!
the God goes with his Ka,
He-With-Two-Eyes goes with his Ka,
You also go with your Ka.
O Unas, the arm of your Ka is before you,
O Unas, the arm of your Ka is behind you,
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is before you,
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is behind you!
Osiris Unas, I give you the Eye of Horus, that your face may be adorned with it, that the perfume of the Eye of Horus may spread towards you!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
22: This is your libation, Osiris, this is your libation, O Unas, coming
- Libation (and) two pellets of natron -
from your son, coming from Horus.
I have come, I bring you the Eye of Horus, so that your heart may be refreshed by it.
I bring it to you to carry you, (to be) under your soles.
23: Take the efflux which comes out of you, that your heart may not be weary thereby.
To say four times:
Take! The voice has come out for you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
26: Semin, semin, open your mouth, O Unas!
Natron of the South, 5 pellets of Elkab.
You taste its taste in front of the divine chapels, that which Horus spits out, semin, that which Seth spits out, semin, the two Harmonious Ones, semin.
To say four times:
You purify yourself with natron, together with the Followers of Horus.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
27: You purify (yourself), Horus purifies (himself),
You purify (yourself), Seth purifies (himself),
Natron of the North, Five pellets of Wadi Natrun
You purify (yourself), Thoth purifies (himself),
You purify (yourself), the god purifies (himself),
you make yourself also pure with what is amongst them, (so that) your mouth is the mouth of a milk calf on the day of its birth

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
28: You purify (yourself), Horus purifies (himself),
you purify (yourself), Seth purifies (himself),
You purify yourself
Natron, one pellet
Thoth purifies (himself), you purify (yourself),
The god purifies (himself)
You purify (yourself), your Ka purifies (himself),
You purify (yourself), purify, you purify (yourself);
this your own self purifies you among your brothers the gods.
29: You purify your mouth, you make pure all your bones, you are adorned with what is yours.
O Osiris, I give you the Eye of Horus that you may adorn your face with it. Adhere (to it)!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
30: O Unas, I make firm for you your two separated jaws.
One psS-kf bread (?)

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, I open for you your mouth!
The divine metal from the South and North.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
31: Unas, take the Eye of Horus to which he went! I bring it to you, put it into your mouth.
Pellets of incense of the South and Pellets of incense of the North

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t: O Unas, take the shik of Osiris! Shik-pellets.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
32: Take the tip of the bodily breast of Horus, take it into your mouth!
A jar of milk.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Take the full (?) breast of your sister Isis, bring it unto your mouth!
An empty menes-jar.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
22: This is your libation, Osiris, this is your libation, O Unas.
To make a libation of the North, round about.
Coming from your son, coming from Horus.
I have come, I bring you the Eye of Horus,
that your heart may be refreshed by it.
I bring it to you to carry you, (to be) under your soles.
23: Take the efflux which comes out of you,
that your heart may not be weary thereby.
To say four times:
Take! The voice has come out for you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
33: Take the two Eyes of Horus, the black and the white one, seize them for your front, that they may brighten your face!
A white jar and a black jar: to be lifted up.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
34: May Re in heaven be pleased with you, may he appease for you the Two Lords, may the night be favorable to you.
A wedjat-cake.
May the Two Mistresses be favorable to you!
A gift which is brought to you is a gift which you see, a gift is what you hear.
A gift is in front of you, a gift is behind you, a gift is your due.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
35: Osiris Unas, take the white teeth of Horus which equip your mouth!
Five cloves of garlic.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
To say four times:
A boon-the-king-gives for the Ka of Unas.
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, (it is) your cake you eat!
A cake of offering.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
36: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus snatched from Seth, which you shall take
- Wine, one white hathes-jar-
to your mouth, that you open your mouth with it!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, open your mouth with what took hold of you!
Wine, one black menu-stone hathes-jar.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
37: Osiris Unas, take the liquid which came out of you!
Beer, one black menu-stone henut-bowl.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
O Re, you are adored in heaven, you are adored for Unas, Lord of all things. For your body are all things, for the Ka of Unas are all things, for his body are all things.
Glorious altar.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
38: Unas, take the Eye of Horus that you may taste it!
One depet-loaf.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Darkness clears up (?).
One ah-cake.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Unas, take the Eye of Horus which you shall find!
One joint of meat.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
39: Unas, take the Eye of Horus which was snatched from Seth, which was rescued for you, that you may open your mouth with it!
Wine, one white menu-stone bowl.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the liquid which came out of Osiris!
Beer, one black menu-stone bowl.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t: 40: Unas, take the Eye of Horus which was rescued for you, which will not separate itself from you! Beer, one iron (?) bowl.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Unas, take the Eye of Horus that you may be provided with it!
Beer, one hetem-bowl.





North Wall - Second Register Translation

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
50: Osiris Unas, I make full your eye (for you) with ointment.
To speak four times - feast, perfume

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the outflow of his face (?)!.
Hekenu-oil.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
51: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus on account of which he fought!
Sefeth-oil.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus of which he took possession!
Neshenem-oil.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus which brought the gods to him through it! Tuat-oil.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
52: O ointment, O ointment, arise, hurry! (You) who are on the brow of Horus, arise!
First quality cedar oil.

Hurry! (You who are) on Horus, you are placed on the brow of this Unas, so that he may feel sweet under you, that you make him a spirit under you.


53: You grant him to have power over his body, you grant that his terror be in the eyes of all the spirits when they look at him, and of everyone who hears his name.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
54: Osiris Unas, I bring you the Eye of Horus which he takes, which is on your brow.
First quality Libyan oil.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
To say four times:
Osiris Unas, the sound Eye of Horus is being rubbed on your face.
Two pouches of green (eye) cosmetic.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
56: You awake in peace, (the goddess) Tayt awakes in peace,
Taytyt awakes
- Two rolls of linen -
in peace!
The Eye of Horus in Dep is in peace,
the Eye of Horus in the Mansions of the Northern Crown is in peace, which the weavers receive, which He-of-the-Sedan-Chair adorns.

57: Cause the Two Lands to bow before this Unas as they bow before Horus!
Cause the Two Lands to fear Unas as they fear Seth!
Be seated before Unas as his god,
open his way in front of the spirits,
that he may stand in front of the spirits like Anubis, He-at-the-Head-of-the-Westerners!
Forward, forward, before Osiris!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
17: He goes, who goes with his Ka!
Horus goes with his Ka,
Seth goes with his Ka.
- Burning incense -
Thoth goes with his Ka
the God goes with his Ka,
Osiris goes with his Ka,
He-With-Two-Eyes goes with his Ka.
You also go with your Ka.


18: O Unas, the arm of your Ka is before you.
O Unas, the arm of your Ka is behind you.
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is before you.
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is behind you.
Osiris Unas, I give you the Eye of Horus that your face may be adorned with it.
To say four times: The perfume of the Eye of Horus spreads towards you!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
22: This is your libation, O Osiris.
This is your libation, O Unas.
Libation: Two pellets.
Coming from your son, coming from Horus.
I have come, I bring you the Eye of Horus, so that your heart may be refreshed by it.
I bring it to carry you, (to be) under your soles.

23: Take the efflux which comes out of you, that your heart may not be weary thereby.
To say four times:
Take! The voice has come out for you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
58: It is Thoth who came with it, he has come out carrying the Eye of Horus.
One table of offerings.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
The Eye of Horus is given to him that he may be satisfied with it.
Come with the Royal Offering!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
59: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus after he has been satisfied with it!
Royal Offering, twice.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Be satisfied with it!
Two offerings of the Broad Hall.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
To say:
You have caused it to retreat before you.
Sit down! Be silent! Royal Invocation - Offering!

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
60: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, join it to your mouth!
Breakfast: one loaf, one beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, take care lest he violate it!
One tetu-bread.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, pulled out by him!
One tareteh-bread.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
61: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the diminished one, of which Seth has eaten!
One mug of djeseret-beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus which they, (acting) against him, destroyed!
One mug of khenmes-beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, lift it to your face!
To lift up one loaf, one beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
62: Lift up your face, Osiris, lift up your face, O Unas, he whose spirit goes. Lift up your face, Unas, honored and sharp, that you see what comes out of you! Praise and partake of it!

63: Wash yourself, Unas, open your mouth with the Eye of Horus! Call your Ka, like Osiris, that he may protect you against every kind of wrath of the dead! Unas, receive this your bread which is the Eye of Horus!


Utterance 94-95
64: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, of which you shall chew, so that you may be adorned with the liquid which goes out of you!
Four times, meal: one loaf, one jar.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the joint, the Eye of Horus!
One joint of meat.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
72: Osiris Unas, unite to yourself the water which is in it!
Two cups of water.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus which purifies his mouth with natron.
Two cups of natron.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, unite it to your mouth!
Breakfast: one bread, one jar.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
73: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the trampled by Seth!
One tetu-loaf.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus pulled out by him!
One tareteh-loaf.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take (it) upon you!
Two heth-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
74: Osiris Unas, I bring you what causes you joy.
Two neher-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, I place your Eye, the tasty.
Four depet-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Prevent him from suffering because of it!
Four pesen-cakes.





North Wall - Third Register

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
75: Osiris Unas, receive your head!
To say four times: four shenes-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take your Eye, seize it!
To say four times: four imta-loaves

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
76: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he swallowed(?)!
Four cake baskets.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus in its glory(?)!
Four hebenenet-baskets.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
77: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, pulled out by him!
Four kemeh-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which is placed in the mouth for you!
Four idat-cakes behind you.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
78: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, your cake, that you may eat!
Four pat-cakes.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he pulled out!
Four pieces of roast.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
79: Osiris Unas, bring to yourself these white and healthy teeth!
Four bunches of onions.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take khepekh, the Eye of Horus!
One foreleg.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
80: Osiris Unas, dance! Geb did not sin against his heir who inherited!
One joint of meat.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, [which you shall embrace].
One joint of sekhenu-meat.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
81: Osiris Unas, take what replaces the Eye of Horus!
One [sut-joint].

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take those who rebel against you!
To say four times: four ribs [of meat].

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
82: Osiris Unas, take your assailant!
To say four times: one pot of roast.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! May you go towards it!
One liver.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
83: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, towards which he goes!
One spleen.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which is on his brow!
One ha-meat.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
84: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which is on the brow of Seth!
Meat, the forequarter.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the severed heads of the Followers of Seth!
One ra-goose.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
85: Osiris, take this desire of (my) heart!
To say four times: one therep-goose.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he has brought.
One set-goose.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
86: Osiris Unas, take to you those who come being hot!
One sr-goose.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Prevent him from sickening on it!
One pigeon.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he pulled out!
One tasif-bread.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
87: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! It shall not be cut off from you!
Two shat-loaves.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, the Eye of Horus is reckoned for you.
Two nepat-baskets.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
88: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the water of which he disclosed!
Two meset-cups.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the diminished one, of which Seth has eaten!
Two cups of djesert beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
89: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! They come who have torn a piece from it.
Two cups of iatet-djesert.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which they destroyed, (acting) against him!
Two cups of khenmes-beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
90: Osiris Unas, equip yourself with the liquid which comes out of you!
Two cups of beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, equip yourself with the liquid which comes out of you!
Two cups of sekhepet.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, equip yourself with the liquid which comes out of you!
Two cups of pekh

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
91: Osiris Unas, equip yourself with the liquid which comes out of you!
Two jars of Nubian beer.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the breast of Horus, which they taste!
Two baskets of figs.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
92: Osiris Unas, open your mouth with it!
Two (cups of) wine of the North.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which they spat out! Prevent him from swallowing it!
Two jars of abesh-wine.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
93: Osiris unas, take the pupil which is in the Eye of Horus, that you may open your mouth with it!
Two cups of Buto wine.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus which he fished up! Open your mouth with it!
Two jars of hamu-wine.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
94: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! It will not separate itself from you!
Two cups of Pelusium wine.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, it is glorious(?).
Two baskets of hebnenet.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
95: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he swallowed(?).
Two baskets of cake.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which he took from Seth.
Two baskets of ished-fruit.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
96: Osiris Unas, take the White Eye of Horus! Prevent him from tearing it out!
Two baskets of white seshet (fruit).

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Green Eye of Horus! Prevent him from tearing it out!
Two baskets of green seshet (fruit).

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
97: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Prevent him from ravishing it!
Two vases of wheat and aghet-corn.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Prevent him from ravishing it!
Two baskets of aghet-corn.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
98: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, while it salutes (you)!
Two baskets of bebat-grain.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, which they chewed!
Two baskets of nebes (fruit).

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
99: Osiris Unas, open your two eyes that you may see with them!
Two baskets of ta-nebes (fruit).

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Prevent him from seizing it!
Two baskets of wah (fruit).

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
100: Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus, the sweet one, which you have caused to return!
Two baskets of all sorts of sweet fruit.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, take the Eye of Horus! Reckon it to you!
Two baskets of all fresh vegetables.

pyramid_texts.title: Sarcophagus Chamber North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
Osiris Unas, hey! Existence is for you, and with you, with you!
Offering.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
115: O Osiris Unas, [turn towards this your bread! Receive it from (my) hand!]
To say four times:
[May the Eye of Horus] flourish (?) for you!
(Diverted) divine offering: bread, cake, and liquid.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
22: This is your libation, O Osiris.
This is your libation, O Unas, coming from your son, coming from Horus.
I have come, I bring you the Eye of Horus, so that your heart may be refreshed by it;
I bring it to you to carry you, (to be) under your soles.

23: Take the efflux which comes out of you, that your heart may not be weary thereby!
To say four times:
Take! The voice has come out for you!
Presentation of a libation.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
16: Osiris, seize every one who hates Unas, who speaks evil against his name!
O Thoth, go, seize him for Osiris!
Bring the one who speaks (evil) against the name of Unas, place him in your hand!
To say four times:
Do not separate yourself from him, take care that you are not separated from him!.
A libation.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
17: He goes who goes with his Ka!
Horus goes with his Ka,
Seth goes with his Ka.
Thoth goes with his Ka,
The God goes with his Ka,
He-With-Two-Eyes goes with his Ka,
You yourself also go with your Ka.
O Unas, the arm of your Ka is before you.
O Unas, the arm of your Ka is behind you.
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is before you.
O Unas, the leg of your Ka is behind you.
Osiris Unas, I give you the Eye of Horus,
that your face may be adorned with it,
that the perfume of the Eye of Horus may spread towards you!

pyramid_texts.title: Passage North Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
116: Salutation, incense!
Salutation, brother divine!
Salutation, Men-wer, he who is in the flesh of Horus!
Great father, spread out in your name "Pellet"!
Your smell is for Unas, your perfume is for Unas!
Eye of Horus, be high, be great for Unas!
Incense.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
249: This is here the (hard) [Eye of Horus. Place it in your hand] that you may be sure of victory and that he (Seth) may fear you!
Breaking of two red jars.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
250: This Unas comes to you, O Nut, this Unas comes to you, O Nut.
He has thrown his father down to earth, he has left a Horus behind him.
His two wings have grown as those of a hawk, (his) two feathers (are those) of a holy hawk.
His soul has brought him (here), his magical power has adorned him.

251: May you open your place in heaven amongst the stars of heaven!
You are indeed the unique star, the comrade of Hu.
May you look down on Osiris, when he gives orders to the spirits!
You stand high up, far from him.
You are not of them, you shall not be of them.

pyramid_texts.title: Passage South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
252: See! This Unas stands among (you), two horns are on his head (like) two wild bulls, for you are indeed the black ram, son of a black sheep, born of a bright sheep, suckled by four sheep-mothers.

253. He comes against you, Horus with blue eyes. Beware of the Horus with red eyes, whose anger is evil, whose power one cannot withstand! His messengers go, his quick runners run, they announce to the One-Who-Lifts-His-Arm-in-the-East

254: that the Unique One in you is going away, (of whom) the God(?) said:
"He will give orders to (my) fathers, the gods".
The gods are silent before you, the Ennead has put their hands before their mouths, before the one in you (i.e., before you) of whom the God said:
"He will give orders to (my) fathers, the gods".

255: Step to the doors of the horizon, and the doors of the Cool Region open (themselves).
You stand (there as a king), ruling over them as Geb rules over his Ennead.
They come in, they strike down evil (with magical spells); they come out, their faces are lifted up.

256: They see you as Min, who rules over the two shrines.
He stands, who stands behind you;
Your brother stands behind you;
Your relative stands behind you;
You do not go under, you will not be annihilated, your name remains with men, your name comes into being with the gods.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
257: To say:
Your son Horus has done (this) for you.
The great ones tremble when they have seen the sword which is in your hand, when you come out of the dusk.


258: Hail to you, Wise One!
Geb has created you, the Ennead has given you birth.
Horus is satisfied with his father, Atum is satisfied with his years.
The gods of the East and of the West are satisfied with this great (event) which took place in the arms of the One-who-Gives-Birth-to-the-God (Nut).


259: Unas there, O Unas, see!
Unas there, O Unas, look!
Unas there, O Unas, hear!
Unas there, O Unas, be there!
Unas there, O Unas, arise on your side!
Do as I order, (you) who hate sleep, you who are tired!
Get up, you who are in Nedjit!
Your fine bread is made (here) in Buto.
Receive your power in Heliopolis!


261: It is Horus to whom order was given to do (this) for his father.
To the Lord of the Storm, wrath is forbidden when he carries you.
It is he who will carry Atum (the All)

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
262: To say:
Unas is a great one,
Unas came out between the thighs of the divine Ennead.
Unas was conceived by Sekhmet;
It is Shesmet who gave him birth


263: (as) to a star with sharp front (sight), with wide stride, which brings provender for the road of Re every day.
Unas has come to his throne which is over the Two Goddessess (who protect Upper and Lower Egypt), and Unas appears as a star.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
264: To say:
O you Two-Contending-Ones, say then to the noble one in this his name:
Unas is from that sesh-sesh-plant which came out of earth;
his hand is cleansed by the one who prepared his seat.


265: Unas is this (flower) at the nose of the Great Mighty One.
Unas has come out of the Isle of Fire, after he has placed truth there in the place of falsehood.
Unas is the guardian of washing, who watches over the Uraei on that night of the Great Flood which comes out of the Great One (sky).


266: Unas appears as Nefertem, the lotus flower at the nose of Re, as he comes out of the Horizon every day, and at the sight of who the gods purify themselves.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
267: To say:
Unas is he who is over the Kas, who unites hearts from the One-over-Wisdom, (he is) the Great One who is in possession of the Divine Book, the Wisdom at the right of Re.


Unas comes to his seat, which is over the Kas.
Unas unites the hearts, (O you) the One-over-Wisdom, the one who art Great!
Unas has become Wisdom, in possession of the Divine Book at the right of Re.

268: (O you) liberated one from the hand of Unas!
Indeed, Unas says what is in the heart of She-the-Great-One (Nut) on the Feast of Red Cloth.
It is Unas, it is Unas the Wisdom at the right hand of Re, deep of heart (?), he who is the ruler of the cavern of Nun.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
269: To say:
O you who are set over the hours, you who go in front of Re, prepare a way for Unas that Unas may pass through the guard (of demons) with terrible faces!


270: Unas is on the way to his throne which is in front of (other) seats behind the god to whom a head has been given back, adorned with the sharp and strong horn of an antelope, (he is like one) who carries a sharp knife which cuts the throat.
(The horn is) the expeller of pain before the bull, the one who chastises those who are in darkness, (it is) the strong horn of the antelope behind the Great God.


271: Unas has overpowered those who were to be punished, Unas has smashed their fronts.
The arm of Unas will not be opposed in the horizon.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
272: To say:
Lift up your face, you gods who are in the Duat!
Unas has come, that you might see him, having become a Great God.
Lead Unas with trembling attire Unas,


273: who has honored you all when he gave orders to men!
Unas (now) judges those who live in the land of Re.
Unas speaks to this pure land after having taken a seat there together with He-Who-Separated-the-Two-Gods (i.e., Thoth).


274: Unas is powerful in relation to him.
Unas lifts his ames-scepter when he intends to refuse admittance to Unas.
Unas sits together with the rowers of the barge of Re.
Unas orders the good, and he executes it.
Unas is the Great God.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall Gable
pyramid_texts.t:
275: To say:
He is purified, who has purified himself in the Fields of Rushes;
Re has purified himself in the Fields of Rushes.
He is purified, who has purified himself in the Fields of Rushes;
this Unas has purified himself in the Fields of Rushes.
The hand of Unas is in the hand of Re.
Nut, take his hand!
Shu, lift him up! Shu, lift him up!"

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
276: To say:
The Great One (the Uraeus) fumigates the Bull of Nehen,
The heat of the fiery breath is against you, you who are about the shrine (of the sun god).
O Great God whose name is unknown, (bring) at once a meal of the Unique Lord.
O lord of the Horizon, make place for Unas!
If you fail to make place for Unas, Unas will pronounce a curse against his father Geb:
the earth shall not speak any more,
Geb shall not be able to defend himself.
(He) whom Unas finds on his way, he will eat him piecemeal.
The Henet-pelican announces, the Ennead-pelican comes out,
the Great One rises (and) the Enneads speak: the land shall be dammed of competely (by complete damming),


279: the two ridges of the mountain will be united, the two banks of the river will be joined, the roads will be hidden from the passers-by, the steps will be annihilated for those who go up!
Make tight the rope (of the boat), sail the road of heaven,
strike the ball on the meadow of Hapy.


280: Ha! Your fields are in fright, O Iad-star, before the pillar of stars, when they have seen the pillar of Kenset, the Bull of Heaven.
How the herdsman of the bull is overwhelmed with awe before him!


281: Ha! fear, tremble, you evil doers, before the storm of heaven!
He has opened the earth with what he knew on the day when he intended to come,


282: so he said, He The-Rich-One-in-Plowland, He-Who-Lives-in-the-Duat -
"See, she comes to meet you, the Beautiful West, to meet you with her beautiful locks!"
She says: "He comes whom I have borne,


283: whose horn shines, the (well) anointed pillar, the Bull of Heaven.
Your form is exalted, pass by in peace!"


284: "I have preserved you", so says she, the Beautiful West, to Unas.
"Go, navigate towards the Field of Offerings that you may bring the hepet to Him-on-His-Kat-bush",


285: so says He-at-the-Head-of-his-Dwellings. "You fall to pieces in the ground, up to your thickness, up to your middle, up to your stretching out.
(Still) you see the sun in his bonds and you praise the sun at his coming out of his bonds with (the help of) Great Protection, He-in-His-Red-Stuff.


286: The Lord of peace gives you his arm.
O you his she-monkeys who cut off the heads, let Unas pass by you in peace.
He has attached his head to his neck while his neck is (well) established on his rump in this his name of He-with-Attached-Head, when he (also) attached the head of the Apis (bull) in it, on the day of lassoing of the Nega-bull.


287: Those whom Unas allowed to get fed...from their drink, they draw from their overflow.
O, may Unas be honored there by those who see him!


288: The Praise-serpent is on its scepter, the Tefnut of Unas, she who supports Shu, she makes his seat wide in Busiris, in Mendes, in the necropolis of Heliopolis, she erects his two supporting stands before the Great One.


289: She excavates a pool for Unas in the Fields of Rushes, she establishes his field in the two Fields of Offerings.
Unas judges in the Great Flood (cow) between the two contending ones,


290: for his strength is the strength of the eye of Teby (the sun god), his vistorious strength is the vistorious strength of the eye of Teby.
Unas has freed himself from those who did this against him, who ravished his meal


291: when it was there, who ravished his evening meal when it was there, who ravished the breath from his nose, and brought to an end the period of his life.
Unas is victoriously stronger than they, appearing (again) on his bank.


292: The hearts (of his enemies) fall into his fingers,
their intestines are for the inhabitants of the sky, their Red (blood) for those of the earth.
Their inheritance is to the poor, their houses are to fire, their land property is to the High Nile.


293: The heart of Unas be glad (sweet), the heart of Unas be glad (sweet)!
Unas is the Unique One, the Bull of Heaven.
He has exterminated those who did this against him, he has annihilated their offspring upon earth.


294: What is before his throne, what he will seize, what he will exalt [is what his father] Shu gave him in the presence of Seth."

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
295: To say:
The horizon fumigates before Horus of Nehen - a meal for the Lords - the Horizon fumigates before Horus of Nehen.
The heat of its fiery breath is against you who surround the shrine (of the sun God).
Its poisonous heat is against you who wear the Great One.


296: The Horizon fumigates before Horus of Nehen, a meal for the lords.
O, Ugly One, whose essence is ugly, whose form is ugly,


297: go away from your seat, lay down on the ground your dignity for Unas.
If you do not go from your seat and lay down on the ground your dignity for this Unas, Unas will come with a face like this Great One, the Lord of the lion helmet, who became powerful through the injury of his eye.


298: Then he will [cause the fire of his eye] to encompass you, so that it sends a storm against those who did (evil), so that it (poison) gushes forth among the Primeval Ones.


299: He will then strike off [the arms of Shu under Nut].
Unas will then lay his arm on this (last) protection, on which you lean.


300: The Great One rises then in his shrine.
[He lays down his dignity on the ground for] Unas after he (Unas) has seized Hu and taken possession of Sia.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
301: To say:
Unas has inherited Geb, Unas has inherited Geb!
He has inherited Atum, he is on the throne of Horus the eldest!
His (Horus') Eye is in his strength, his protection is what has been done against him.


302: The heat of the fire of his Uraeus is (like) Renenutet, which is on him.
Unas has put his fear into their hearts by making a massacre amongst them.


303: The gods have seen (it), while (they) took their clothes off; they bow before Unas while praising:
"Row him, O his mother, tow him, O (his) native place!
Hey, loose the rope!"

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
304: To say:
Excitement in heaven!
"We see something new!" say the gods of Primeval Times.
"O Ennead, a (new) Horus is in the sunlight, the lords of forms serve him, the Two whole Enneads attend him,


305: as he sits on the seat of the Lord of All.
Unas takes heaven, he splits its brass, Unas is led on the ways of the Becoming One.


306: Unas goes to peace, being alive in the West, and the inhabitants of the Duat serve him.
Unas shines again in the East, the One-Who-Separates-the-Quarrelers comes to him, bowing.
"Serve him, you gods, he is older than the Great One".
Says he, "He took his seat!".


307: Unas takes Hu, Eternity is brought to him, Sia is placed at his feet.
Jubilate for Unas, he has taken the Horizon!"

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
308: To say:
Osiris is Unas in a dust storm.
His horror is the earth.
Unas did not enter into Geb that he might be annihilated, that he might sleep in his house upon earth, that his bones might be broken.
His injuries are effaced.
He has purified himself with the Eye of Horus.
His injuries are effaced by the two female kites of Osiris,
Unas has freed himself from the discharge (of his wounds) in Kus into earth.


309: His sister, the Lady of Pe, is the one who bewailed him.
Unas is on the way to heaven, Unas is on the way to heaven, with the wind, with the wind.
He will not be hindered, there is no one who might hinder him.
There will be no session on his behalf in the court of the god.
Unas is on his own, the eldest of the gods.


310: His cake comes up together with (the one for) Re, his great offering meal comes out of Nwn.
Unas is one who returns, he comes and goes together with Re.
His houses are being visited by him.


311: Unas appoints the Kas, he ravishes the Kas, he punishes and effaces injuries.
Unas spends the day, he spends the night, while he pacifies the Two Hoes in Hermopolis.
His foot is not hindered, his heart is not opposed.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber West Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
316: To say:
"O Geb, Bull of Nut, a Horus is Unas, the heir of his father.
Unas is he who went and came back, the fourth of these four gods who have brought the water, who have made a purification, ...(continued on the South Wall)

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
324: To say:
"Unas is a heart-thrower, the son of the heart of Shu.
(He is) spread out an outspreading, with a terrible light.
Unas it is who burns before the wind to the limits of heaven, to the limits of earth, as soon as the hands of Lightning are emptied of Unas.


325: Unas traverses the air (Shu) and passes over the earth (Aker).
He kisses the Red Crown as one hurled by a god.
Those in the tree crowns (?) open their arms to him.
Unas stands on the east side of the vault of Heaven and what rises to the road of Heaven is brought to him.
It is Unas, the message of the Storm.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
327: To say:
Ignore not Unas, O god! You know him for he knows you, for he knows you.


328: Ignore not Unas, O Re! You know him for he knows you.
Ignore not Unas, O Re! It is to be said to you - "Greatest One of all the annihilated".


329: Ignore not Unas, O Thoth! You know him for he (also) knows you.
Ignore not Unas, O Thoth. It is to be said to you: 'The one in peace'.


330: Ignore not Unas, O Horus Sothis! You know him for he (also) knows you.
Ignore not Unas, O Horus of Sothis! It is to be said to you: "Unfortunate One."


331: Ignore not Unas, O You who are in the Duat!
You know him for he knows you.
Ignore not Unas, O You who are in the Duat!
It is to be said to you - "He who awakes in good health".


332: Ignore not Unas, O Bull of Heaven!
You know him for he knows you.
Ignore not Unas, O Bull of Heaven.
It is to be said to you - "This Neheh-star".


333: See, Unas comes, see, Unas comes!
See, Unas has gone up!
Unas, however, comes not by himself, it is an embassy which came to him.


334. Unas has passed by his dangerous place, the fury of the great sea avoided him.
His fare is not taken in the Great Ferryboat.
The Shrine of the Great Ones could not ward him off the road of the Sehedu-stars.


335: See then, Unas has reached the height of Heaven!
He has seen his Self in the Night Barge;
It is Unas who rowed on it.
He has recognized his Swelling Uraeus in the Morning Barge.
It was Unas who has bailed it out.


336: The People of Light bore witness for him;
the hail showers of the sky took hold of him.
They let Unas ascend to Re."

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
337. To say:
The two Reed Floats of the sky are laid down for Re, that he may cross to the Horizon.
The two Reed Floats of the sky are laid down for Horus of the Horizon, that Horus of the Horizon may cross on them to Re.
The two reed floats of the sky are laid down for Unas, that he may cross on them to Horus of the Horizon, to Re.


338: It was pleasant for Unas to be with his Ka and he lives together with his Ka.
His panther skirt is on him, his Ames-scepter is on his arm, his Aba-scepter is in his hand.


339: He(?) those who go to them, and they bring him those four spirits, the eldest ones, at the head of the curly ones who stand at the eastern side of the sky, who lean on their scepters.


340: in order that (these four spirits) say to Re the beautiful name of Unas, and announce this Unas to Neheb-Kau, in order that the entrance of this Unas be greeted.
The Fields of Rushes are filled (with water) to let Unas cross the Sinuous Watercourse.


341: This Unas will cross a crossing to the eastern side of the Horizon.
This Unas will cross a crossing to the eastern side of the sky.
His sister is Sothis, his place of birth is the Twilight (Duat).

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
364: To say:
Your heart belongs to you, O Osiris, your two feet belong to you, O Osiris, your arm belongs to you, O Osiris.
The heart of Unas belongs to him, himself, his two feet belong to him, himself, his arm belong to him, himself.


365: The earth is beaten into steps for him towards heaven, that he may mount on it towards heaven, and he rises on the smoke of the great fumigation.


366: He flies away, this Unas, as goose, he alights as a beetle, he flies away as an goose, he alights as a beetle on the empty throne which is in your boat, O Re.


367: Stand up, begone, you who do not know the thicket of rushes, that Unas may sit on your seat, that he may row in the sky in your boat, O Re!


368: This Unas pushes off from Earth (being) in your boat, O Re. When you come out of the Horizon, he has his scepter in his hand as one who sails your boat, O Re.


369: You approach Heaven, you are far from Earth, being far from wife and the kilt.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
370: To say:
This Unas washes himself, Re appears, the great Ennead shines, the One from Ombos (Seth) is high, ruler of the Iteret-palace.


371. This Unas ravishes mankind as his (own) limb. this Unas seizes the Very Great Crown from the two Enneads.
Isis takes care of him, Nephtys suckles him.


372: Horus takes him to his side, he purifies this Unas in the Jackal Lake, he cleans the Ka of this Unas in the Lake of Dawn, he rubs down the flesh of the Ka of this Unas as well as his own, with what is with Re on the Horizon, with what he (Re) receives,


373: when the Two Lands are lighted, and he opens the face of the gods.
He takes the Ka of this Unas as well as himself to the Great Castle, after courts have been made for him and the 'wire' has been attached for him.


374: This Unas leads the Imperishable Stars, he crosses to the Fields of Rushes.
The inhabitants of the Horizon row him, the inhabitants of the Cool Region (sky) convey him.


375: Excellent is this Unas being excellent; his arms do not fail him.
Foremost is this Unas being foremost, his Ka comes to him.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
376: To say:
The fire is laid, the fire shines, the incense is placed on the fire, the incense shines.
Your smell comes to Unas, O incense,
the smell of Unas comes to you, O incense.


377: Your smell comes to Unas, you gods, the smell of Unas comes to you, you gods!
May Unas be with you, you gods, may you be together with Unas, you gods!
May Unas live with you, you gods, may you live with Unas, you gods!


378: May Unas love you, you gods, love him, you gods!
The paq-pellet comes, the padj-pellet comes, which come out of the knee of Horus.


379: They come who have risen up, they come who have risen up;
they come who have climbed up, they come who have climbed up;
they come who have risen up like Shu, they come who have risen up like Shu.
Unas climbs on the knees of Isis, this Unas ascends on the knees of Nephthys.


380: The father of Unas, Atum, seizes the arm of Unas, and he assigns Unas to those gods who are quick and clever, the Imperishable Stars.


381: Mother of Unas, Ipy, give this your breast to this Unas that this Unas may pass it over his mouth, that he may suck this your white, clear, sweet milk.


382: That land into which Unas goes, he will not thirst in it, he will not hunger in it, eternally.

pyramid_texts.title: Antechamber South Wall
pyramid_texts.t:
383: To say:
Awake in peace, You-Whose-Face-is-Behind, in peace, You-who-looks-behind, in peace, Ferryman of the Sky, in peace, Ferryman of Nut, in peace, Ferryman of the Gods, in peace!


384: Unas comes to you, that you may ferry him in that ferryboat in which you ferry the gods.


385: Unas comes to his side as a god who comes to his side.
Unas comes to his sidelock (side) as a god who comes to his sidelock (side).
